tools.name: get_demo_fhir_bundle
tools.description: Use this when a prototype or test needs the complete fictional FinchNode FHIR R4 Bundle for one scenario and its resource references. Behaviors apply to record reads only, so every scenario returns its Bundle.

tools.name: search_demo_fhir
tools.description: Use this to get all resources of one FHIR R4 type for one synthetic scenario's patient (baseline-adult unless patient_id names another).

tools.name: simulate_demo_connect
tools.description: Use this to prototype the FinchNode connection journey. Returns a non-persistent synthetic session: complete for a record or behavior scenario, or the connect-cancelled or connect-failed outcome with no patient.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_demo_medications" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

No account or API key. remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
